description: Adapt Alaska is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Alaska Sea Grant; University of Alaska Fairbanks | College of Fisheries and Ocean Sciences; Alaska Center for Climate Assessment & Policy. Alaskans can use this tool to initiate the process of climate adaptation in their state. Adapt Alaska was created to inform decision makers of the resources available to them to adapt to the rapid environmental changes. The site features three main sections:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
